title: Stop Pasting Your Whole Chat History Into AI (Do This Instead)
description: A giant chat-history dump tells your AI less than three short standing files: who you are, how you like the work done, and a dated pointer-log of key facts. Run Prompt #16 from The Prompt Bodega 60 to lock in your voice. Free Starter 10: link in profile.
